prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: TWENTY achievement medal icons for an adult university Spanish-learning website. Generate ONE single contact sheet with EXACTLY20 separate small badges arranged in a PRECISE5COLUMNS by4ROWS regular grid, row-major order. Each badge fully contained inside its own equal rectangular cell, centred, with very generous TRANSPARENT space on all four sides; no touching neighbours, no crossing cell boundaries. Entire background genuinely TRANSPARENT with alpha, not a printed checkerboard, not white. No borders between cells. All20badges must be present, same approximate scale and same coherent polished flat illustrated enamel-medallion style: rounded dark university green#024638 ink outlines, mint, white enamel and warm gold accents, friendly hand-drawn character but crisp simple symbols readable at64px. Small ribbons/laurels may vary to distinguish tiers. No photographs, no3D, no heavy drop shadows, no text, letters, numbers, labels, watermarks or logos. Each badge a complete isolated icon with transparent outside.
ROW1 from LEFT to RIGHT:1small pencil with a checkmark inside green medallion;2open book with checkmark inside green-and-gold medal;3three small gold stars inside green medal;4exercise workbook and pencil on a mint shield;5five gold stars arranged in an arc above a green workbook.
ROW2 LEFT to RIGHT:6stack of workbooks framed by a gold laurel;7story scroll and quill inside green medallion;8open storybook with rising sun and small green ribbon;9book with a bridge arch and gold ribbon;10book with a mountain summit and green flag.
ROW3 LEFT to RIGHT:11storybook centred on a five-point gold star;12small bookshelf with a gold star seal;13stack of colourful storybooks with full green laurel wreath;14pencil writing inside a speech bubble on a green shield;15bright gold diamond with green checkmark, perfect result.
ROW4 LEFT to RIGHT:16green diamond checkmark encircled by five small gold stars;17small playful gold rocket on green round badge, optional challenge;18constellation of five gold stars inside green medallion;19half-complete gold laurel wreath around a green progress compass;20THE GRAND FINAL medal, an elegant gold laurel wreath around a deep-green shield with open book and a large gold star, modest green ribbons, most prestigious but same size. Avoid human hands or people. Exactly twenty distinct complete icons. Absolutely no additional icons or captions.
extraction: scripts/crop-achievements.ps1 detects occupied alpha bands, crops each icon and centres it on a 336 × 336 transparent PNG canvas.
criteria: dist/achievements.js maps each image to its achievement and unlocking condition.
format_note: PNG with true alpha transparency; generated raster artwork is preserved as raster instead of embedded in an SVG wrapper.
